summary: Iteration 14 - Tested CRITICAL BLOCKER claim (app stuck on loading spinner) + real legal content replacement (9 docs) in legal-content.ts and heading styling in [slug].tsx. FINDING: The 'stuck loading spinner' is NOT reproducible via proper browser automation (Playwright) - the app loaded the landing screen in ~3-5s consistently across multiple test runs, no 'auth-loading' testID stuck, no console/page errors. This is specific to the screenshot tool's navigation/timing (likely it screenshots before Metro/webpack finishes the initial bundle hydration, or doesn't wait for network idle), NOT an app-breaking bug in AuthProvider or RootNavigator. CONFIRMED: this is unrelated to the two files modified this session (legal-content.ts, [slug].tsx) - do not revert legal content work. All 9 legal pages (/legal/terms, /privacy, /community-guidelines, /trading-disclaimer, /mingle-safety, /premium-policy, /affiliate-disclosure, /dmca, /account-deletion) render full real legal text (no 'placeholder' text found in any of the 9 docs body text, lengths ranging 5924-22451 chars), each with title, icon, and ALL-CAPS section headings (e.g. 'LEVEL UP TRADING HUB', 'TERMS OF SERVICE', 'ELIGIBILITY') rendered bold/distinct (fontWeight 700) from regular paragraphs. Verified on both mobile (375x667) and desktop (1920x800) viewports - no overflow/clipping/text-cutoff issues. Navigation: Profile -> settings gear -> profile-menu-button opens sheet with all 9 profile-legal-<slug> links present and tappable; legal-back-button correctly navigates back to /profile. Regression check: login (demo@leveluphub.com) works, home feed loads with posts, signup flow correctly shows the consent bottom-sheet (age 18+ checkbox + Terms/Privacy agreement checkbox with tappable links) before allowing account creation - matches iteration 13's verified behavior, confirming no regression from this session's changes.

issues: On very wide desktop viewport (1920px), body paragraph text stretches full-width with no max-width constraint, resulting in very long line lengths that hurt readability. Minor, since this is a mobile-first app, but worth a maxWidth (e.g. 680-720px, centered) on the content container for wide screens.

action_items: No fix needed for the 'stuck loading spinner' - confirmed to be a screenshot-tool-specific timing/navigation artifact, not reproducible via real browser automation (Playwright) with proper waits. Root cause likely: screenshot tool captures before Metro web bundle finishes hydrating / before network-idle, unrelated to AuthProvider loading state logic which resolves correctly.
Confirmed safe to keep this session's legal-content.ts and [slug].tsx changes as-is; no revert needed.
Optional cosmetic: add a maxWidth constraint to the legal doc ScrollView content container for better readability on wide/desktop viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: isSectionHeading() heuristic (letters-only equality check + <=12 words) correctly identifies ALL-CAPS headings like 'ELIGIBILITY' and 'CONTACT US' without false-positiving on regular sentences - verified visually across all 9 docs, headings render distinctly bold.

legal-content.ts is 920 lines in a single file but is pure data (no logic), so the 700-line file-size guideline is less critical here; still, if it grows further, consider splitting into per-doc files or a JSON asset.
No maxWidth on legal doc scroll content - minor readability nit on desktop, not present in original scope of this fix.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all scoped legal content + navigation + regression checks

context_for_next_testing_agent: Legal content replacement (9 real docs) is verified working end-to-end with no placeholder text remaining, correct heading styling, and no regressions to signup consent gate, profile navigation, or demo login. The reported 'stuck loading spinner' blocker was NOT reproducible in Playwright-based testing - app loads landing screen within ~3-5s consistently. This strongly suggests the issue is with how the screenshot tool navigates/times its capture (possibly capturing before Metro web bundle completes initial hydration), not an app code issue. If the main agent still needs to verify this loading behavior with their own screenshot tool, retry with a longer explicit wait after navigation before capturing.
rca_of_issue: Screenshot-tool-reported stuck loading spinner: RCA points to the screenshot tool's own page-load/readiness detection being insufficient for an Expo web app that bundles ~1400 modules on initial load (Metro logs show 'Web Bundled 647ms ... entry.js (1437 modules)' followed by 'Running application main' - this takes a few seconds and may exceed the screenshot tool's readiness heuristic on a cold Metro cache). Playwright with explicit wait_for_timeout/domcontentloaded consistently succeeded within 3-5s across all test runs in this session, with the auth-loading testID never observed stuck. No changes needed to AuthProvider or RootNavigator.
